##Wind##

##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East becoming variable 3 or less.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first, then occasional rain.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers.
